note: Primary endpoint frozen before seed-43 training. Stratified paired bootstrap: resample episodes within each task, equal-weight the three task differences.

classification.reasoning: All three independently trained Flow models show a POSITIVE aggregate F4-F1 effect of broadly comparable scale: +0.0318, +0.0387, +0.0246 (mean +0.0317, sd 0.0070, range 0.0141). The aggregate endpoint is the frozen primary statistic and it replicates in direction and magnitude across N=3. Category A explicitly permits task-level heterogeneity, which is present.
classification.task_heterogeneity: Task localisation remains unstable. The 4-cube effect is NEGATIVE for seed 42 (-0.0286) but positive for seeds 43 (+0.0677) and 44 (+0.0417). The 3-cube effect ranges 0.0046 to 0.0428 (9x) and the 5-cube effect 0.0021 to 0.0813 (39x). No object count carries the effect consistently.
classification.interaction_hypothesis: Not supported by any seed. Ordered 3/4/5: seed 42 +/-/+ , seed 43 +/+/+ decreasing after 4 cubes, seed 44 +/+/+ decreasing monotonically. There is no monotone increase of the low-NFE penalty with object count in any seed.
classification.statistical_caveat: N=3 training seeds. No t-test is reported: with N=3 the power is negligible and a p-value would be misleading. Episode-level bootstrap CIs are checkpoint-level only and episodes are never pooled across seeds (that would be 864 episodes masquerading as algorithm-level evidence).
